(Photo courtesy of TJ Lopez, volunteer) As the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) commemorates 80 years of public‑land stewardship , we continue to highlight the everyday efforts that strengthen our connection to communities and the landscapes we protect. One recent example comes from Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area , where a local student film has brought new attention to the work of BLM rangers and to the spirit of partnership that defines public land management. BLM Nevada Park Ranger Chad Hoing played a central role in a College of Southern Nevada (CSN) student film created by filmmaker Carl Petersen — an impactful piece that was officially selected for a CSN showcase and won an award for its outstanding quality and storytelling. This recognition was highlighted by colleagues, who shared that the film’s success was no surprise given the strength of Hoing’s performance and presence on camera.

Combined lease bonus bids and rentals are distributed between the federal government and state where parcels are located. This lease sale was conducted under the Working Families Tax Cut Act , which resets the royalty rate for new federal onshore oil and gas production to a minimum of 12.5%, reversing the 16.67% rate set by the Inflation Reduction Act. When wildfire conditions make direct suppression difficult or unsafe, firefighters look for places where they can use the landscape to slow a fire's spread. Reducing vegetation along roads can create a break in fuels, giving firefighters another option if conditions change. Crews removed vegetation within approximately 75 feet of the roadside to create a potential firebreak if the fire moved in that direction. It is the underlying technology for many cryptocurrency systems, but it can also be used in other types of applications. A blockchain is the ledger itself. It contains transactional records that are grouped into blocks. Each block is cryptographically linked to the previous block, making the ledger tamper evident. If data in an earlier block is changed, the cryptographic link to that block changes, and the change can be detected in later blocks. As new blocks are added, older blocks become more difficult to modify, creating tamper resistance. A blockchain network is the network in which a blockchain is used. Copies of the ledger are maintained across nodes in the network, and new blocks are added according to established validation and consensus rules. This distributed structure, together with cryptographic mechanisms, helps make the blockchain resilient to later attempts to alter the ledger. Radio Sheffield's Praise or Grumble was first broadcast on 16 November 1986 to give disgruntled fans of clubs in South Yorkshire and North Derbyshire the chance to moan about their team's performance on a Saturday afternoon. Initially dedicated to grumbles, the show's unique format was soon expanded to include praise. Speaking at Monday's unveiling, Praise or Grumble's longest-running presenter Andy Giddings said: "It's not about who sits in the chair, it's about the people who get involved. Responsibilities of OSI Board Directors The board’s responsibilities include oversight of the organization, supporting the executive director and staff. The board approves the budget, sets strategic direction and defines goals in line with the mission and bylaws . OSI directors are expected to work actively and pro-actively as a member of the board, OSI and open source community. It is understood directors are volunteers, and each will be engaged in professional and personal responsibilities outside OSI. For different reasons, related to work, college/university, family, etc. there will be periods of time where a director will be busy and/or can not commit to the demands of the board or community, either as much as one would like or as much as is needed. However, this should be the exception, not the rule. Each board member is expected to sign the Board member agreement . While American baseball has never been shy about applying a global moniker to its domestic contests (it is called the World Series after all), Bobby Thomson’s iconic pennant-winning home run against the Brooklyn Dodgers on Oct. 3, 1951 really did deserve the globe-spanning moniker. These games were among the first to receive nationwide broadcast on television and radio, with the call also going out to U.S. service members around the world thanks to Armed Forces Radio. And then there was Thomson, who was originally born in a two-room tenement building in Glasgow, becoming known in the States as “The Staten Island Scot.” But what was the reaction back in Thomson’s homeland of Scotland? ​ “Every once in a while, you do come across somebody who's aware of Bobby Thomson, but I wouldn't say it's in everyday Scottish sports folklore,” John Tafe, an American ex-pat and the current president of Baseball Scotland, told MLB.com. “He's not on the pantheon of Scottish heroes or anything like that. The District has many challenges to face as it balances its mission of multiple use and sustainable yield to achieve a sustainable ecosystem. Some of the major activities occurring within the district include: livestock grazing, wildland fire suppression, as well as motorized and non-motorized recreation. The Boise District is divided into three geographic areas/field offices: Bruneau (1.4 million acres), Four Rivers (1.3 million acres) and Owyhee (1.2 million acres). The District also manages Idaho's only National Conservation Area, Morley Nelson Snake River Birds of Prey (487,000 acres), home to the greatest concentration of nesting birds of prey in North America – and perhaps, the world. Some 800 pairs of hawks, owls, eagles and falcons come each spring to mate and raise their young here. pages.text: Bolt | Glossary | MLB.com Bolt Definition A Bolt is any run where the Sprint Speed (defined as "feet per second in a player's fastest one-second window") of the runner is at least 30 ft/sec. Players' Bolt totals for each season are displayed on the Sprint Speed leaderboard . It is a cumulative stat, unlike Sprint Speed. Billy Hamilton finished first or second in Bolts in each of the first four seasons in Statcast history. Trea Turner ranked first in 2018, with 145 Bolts -- 43 more than any other player -- though he ranked fourth on the Sprint Speed leaderboard (min. 10 competitive runs). Since Statcast was implemented Major League-wide in 2015, the number of Bolts per season typically has been similar to the number of stolen bases. For example, there were 2,377 Bolts and 2,474 steals in 2018. The inhabitants of San Juan aren’t early risers. At 9am, the city’s streets are largely empty. In the Plaza Colón, there’s a cockerel scrabbling about in the flower beds. Every computer and phone uses hundreds of SQLite databases and there are over one trillion SQLite databases in active use. Hence, the importance of examining the data held in these databases in an investigation, including deleted data when possible, is paramount. This book fully explains the format of the SQLite database file. It shows how records are encoded, how to decode them manually and how to decode records that are partially overwritten. It also describe how the workings of SQLite, and in particular the journal and WAL, can be used to ascertain what has happened in a manner that cannot be determined from the data alone. The book covers basic SQL queries and how they can be used to create a custom report that includes data from different tables, and shows how one can use SQL queries to test hypotheses about the relationships of data in different tables. Close booktiger's Diary [转载]可不能“随手一标”！ Posted by booktiger on 17 October 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . 可不能“随手一标”！ 来源：国家安全部 2026年10月17日07:03 北京 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Xri2QFc-6VPpZ6QLBaqjgw 一张看似普通的网络地图，一个出于“兴趣”的随手标注，竟可能危害国家秘密安全。近年来，随着地理信息技术的普及，“开放地图”平台逐渐走入公众视野，但其背后隐藏的国家安全风险却不容忽视。 一个“爱好”带来的麻烦 2021年，许某在社交媒体上被一张带有艺术风格的路网地图所吸引。出于好奇，他开始接触境外开放地图平台，并违法“翻墙”访问。许某凭借对居住地周边环境的了解，以及从互联网搜集的公开信息，开始在境外开放地图平台上标注各类地理信息，多次标注军队等涉密敏感单位的位置信息。国家安全机关发现许某违法行为后迅速采取行动，依法对其开展审查。面对审查，许某懊悔道：“我完全没想到，自己只是出于爱好做点标记，竟会触犯法律，威胁国家安全。”国家安全机关向其宣讲了相关法律法规，讲明了其行为的危害性，并依法对其进行处理。许某表示已深刻认识到错误，并积极配合消除隐患。 随手一标，隐患巨大 “开放地图”一般指数据开源、可自由使用与编辑的地图项目，经常由全球志愿者共同创建、编辑并免费共享地理数据，在碳中和、城乡交通建设、灾害风险评估研究等方面具备相应应用价值。但如果在开放地图平台上标注我国涉密敏感地理信息，就有可能被不法分子利用，对我国家安全造成危害。不法分子无需动用复杂的技术手段，仅凭开放地图便能轻易获取我国涉密敏感单位的位置、规模等信息，并据此在军事基地等涉密敏感单位附近开展“黑飞”、偷拍、测绘等活动。境外间谍情报机关还可能结合其他渠道获取的信息进行多源数据交叉比对，拼凑成完整情报，甚至还可能对涉密单位工作人员以及周边居民、商户等人员开展针对性的渗透、拉拢和策反活动，对我国家安全构成严重威胁。 国家安全机关提示 《 中华人民共和国保守国家秘密法 》《 中华人民共和国测绘法 》《 公开地图内容表示规范 》等法律法规划出清晰底线：个人或者组织非法获取、持有、提供、利用属于国家秘密的地理信息的，将被依法追责。开放地图不是个人兴趣的“涂鸦板”，看似无心的标注可能触碰国家秘密“红线”。 ——绷紧“安全弦”。增强国家安全意识，不在地图平台标注任何涉及军事基地、涉密单位的地理信息。 ——把好“出口关”。不在社交平台发布涉密场所周边照片、视频，拍照前留意背景是否涉及敏感场所，不转发、不扩散任何标注有涉密地理信息的地图内容。 ——当好“守护者”。如发现在公开地图标注涉密地理信息等危害国家安全的可疑情况，请及时通过12339国家安全机关举报受理电话、网络举报受理平台（ www.12339.gov.cn ）、国家安全部微信公众号举报受理渠道或者直接向当地国家安全机关进行举报。 Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

New BMF capabilities include: Electron Beam Lithography: The JEOL JBX-6300FS e-beam lithography tool allows wafer-level lithography of features as small as 8 nm. Compared to our former capability, it has 1000 times better position registration and 1000 times faster write speed. It will facilitate advances in nanoscale metrology and the fabrication of quantum information devices, single-photon detectors, biomagnetic reporters, magnetic sensors and memory elements, and superconducting devices.
